gaps.sentence: They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.

gaps.sentence: She put her ideas ___ clearly and confidently.
gaps.explanation: put across = communicate an idea successfully.

gaps.sentence: Do you get ___ well with your new colleagues?
gaps.explanation: get on (with) = have a good relationship; also get along with (AmE).

gaps.sentence: She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).

gaps.sentence: She's taken ___ knitting to relax after work.
gaps.explanation: take up = start (a hobby, sport, activity).

gaps.sentence: A sales rep will follow ___ your enquiry next week.
gaps.explanation: follow up = take further action after something.
